subject: POC wrap: Brightline throughput & cost wins — quick soundbite + 15m
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Paula Renteria <paula.renteria@brightlineretail.com>, Kevin Huang <kevin.huang@brightlineretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC wrap: Brightline throughput & cost wins — quick soundbite + 15m

Hi Paula / Kevin,

Thanks again for running the week-long POC with us — the team really appreciated the close collaboration. I pulled together the headline numbers from the test (attached spreadsheet) so you have them in one place:

- Inference throughput: 3.6x improvement on identical instance types (avg qps up from 120 to 430)
- Median latency: 48ms -> 18ms (all prompt configs)
- 95th percentile latency: 210ms -> 75ms
- Cost per 1k tokens: down ~58% with smart batching + KV cache enabled
- Error rate: stable at <0.2% across test window

Attachments: brightline_poc_metrics.xlsx, screenshot_latency_chart.png

Would you be open to two small things that would really help our launch materials?
1) A one-line soundbite we can use on the site (example: "Brightline reduced inference cost by over half while cutting median latency by 63%"). If you'd rather edit it, a one-sentence alternative is great.
2) A quick 15-minute call this week to capture a 10–15 second audio clip and confirm attribution (company name + logo use).

Proposed times (PT): Tue 5/4 11:30–11:45, Wed 5/5 10:00–10:15, or Wed 5/5 15:00–15:15. If none work, tell me a slot and we’ll make it work.

If you prefer to reply with a short line instead of a call, that works too. Thanks, Paula — your voice is the most valuable part of this.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear recap and for the team's help during the test. Great to see the consolidated numbers.

A short line you can use: "Working with Redwood cut our inference cost by more than half and made responses noticeably faster for our customers."

If you need a tighter metric-driven line: "We saw ~58% reduction in token cost and median latency drop from 48ms to 18ms during the POC."

We’re happy to be quoted and to have our logo used. One small ask: if you publish the exact numbers, please keep them as "approximate" (e.g., ~58%) rather than precise figures — we want to avoid implying guarantees across all workloads.

I can join a brief call Wednesday 5/5 at 10:00 PT. Kevin will join too.

Thanks — Paula
Paula Renteria
Head of AI Ops, Brightline Retail

Phone: (312) 555-4382
